title: 不定代词与前文指代

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct subject–verb agreement.
options: Someone is waiting by the bridge.
Someone be waiting by the bridge.
Someone were waiting by the bridge.
Someone are waiting by the bridge.
answers: Someone is waiting by the bridge.
questions.evidence: Someone is waiting by the bridge.
questions.explanation: someone 作单数主语，搭配 is。

questions.prompt: Use a natural indefinite pronoun: Did ____ check the notice?
questions.explanation: 疑问句中 anyone 表示“有人吗”；did 后用动词原形。

options: We did not see anyone at the shelter.
We did not sees anyone at the shelter.
We did not saw anyone at the shelter.
We did not seeing anyone at the shelter.
answers: We did not see anyone at the shelter.
questions.evidence: We did not see anyone at the shelter.
questions.explanation: did not 后接原形 see，anyone 可用于否定句。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about every person.
options: Everyone have a copy of the note.
Everyone has a copy of the note.
Everyone having a copy of the note.
Everyone are a copy of the note.
answers: Everyone has a copy of the note.
questions.evidence: Everyone has a copy of the note.
questions.explanation: everyone 语法上通常作单数，搭配 has。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that nothing is on the path.
options: There is nothing on the path.
There is nothing are on the path.
There is not nothing on the path.
There are nothing on the path.
answers: There is nothing on the path.
questions.evidence: There is nothing on the path.
questions.explanation: nothing 表示“没有东西”，there is 与之搭配。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about an unclear detail.
questions.explanation: anything 作单数，疑问句用 Is。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about one thing to check.
questions.explanation: something 通常按单数处理，此处后接 to check。

questions.prompt: Complete the standard negative sentence: We did not find ____.
questions.explanation: 否定句中的 anything 表示“任何东西”。

questions.prompt: The museum is closed today. ____ opens tomorrow.
questions.evidence: it 常指前文的单数事物，they / them 常指复数人或事物；this / that 可指前面提到的情况。

questions.prompt: The visitors are at the entrance. ____ want to see the exhibit.
questions.evidence: it 常指前文的单数事物，they / them 常指复数人或事物；this / that 可指前面提到的情况。
questions.explanation: they 回指复数 visitors，并作主语。

questions.prompt: A note says the door is beside the window, and the door is locked. Which sentence keeps both facts clear?
options: The door beside the window are locked.
The door beside the window is locked.
It beside the window is locked.
The window beside the door is locked.
answers: The door beside the window is locked.
questions.evidence: 若一个代词可能指两个对象，要重写名称消除歧义。
questions.explanation: 明确重复 door，既保留位置关系，又指出上锁的是门。

questions.prompt: The sign displays two dates. Read the sign itself: Please read ____.
questions.evidence: it 常指前文的单数事物，they / them 常指复数人或事物；this / that 可指前面提到的情况。
questions.explanation: 题干要求读单数 sign 本身，用作宾语的 it；them 会指两个日期。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations. Questions 1–8 are guided practice; questions 9–12 use the rules in new contexts.
passage:
1. somebody / someone 指某个人；anybody / anyone 常用于疑问或否定句。它们作主语时通常接单数动词。语境决定所指，不要仅凭肯定或否定机械判断。
例句：Someone is waiting by the bridge. Did anyone check the notice? We did not see anyone at the shelter. Everyone has a copy of the note.

2. something 常指某件事，anything 可用于疑问句或否定句；nothing 表示没有任何事物。nothing 本身已有否定意义，标准英语中不再额外用 not 表示同一次否定。
例句：There is nothing on the path. Is anything unclear? There is something to check. We did not find anything.

3. it 常指前文的单数事物，they / them 常指复数人或事物；this / that 可指前面提到的情况。若一个代词可能指两个对象，要重写名称消除歧义。
例句：The route is long. It starts at the library. The visitors are ready. They have their notes.
